card.name: Nationality adjective after "the"
card.fires_on: Nationality or language adjectives such as English, Iranian, American, Russian or Chinese right after "the", where a noun like language, plateau, West or interior comes next.

modes.example: (DOE) defines the vocabulary of the first six centuries (C.E. 600-1150) of the<< English>> language, using twenty-first century technology.

modes.label: Regional adjective
modes.description: A national or regional adjective after "the" that names a place or area.
modes.example: moved the capital to Moscow—deep in the<< Russian>> interior.

card.writes: It pushes toward nouns about peoples, languages and places, and away from subject-area nouns like history, syntax and dynamics.
card.plain: It marks a country or language adjective, like English or Iranian, that sits after "the" and is waiting for its noun.
